specs.Battery: Equipped with a rechargeable battery, the HGWorld PS4 Wireless Controller offers up to 10 hours of continuous gaming on a full charge.
specs.Buttons: Features 4 action buttons, dual analog sticks, a D-pad, and motion-sensitive controls. The DualShock vibration feedback provides an immersive gaming experience.
specs.Compatible Android Games: Compatible with a wide range of Android games, the HGWorld PS4 Wireless Controller offers versatile gaming for mobile players using Bluetooth connectivity.
specs.Compatible IOS Games: The HGWorld PS4 Wireless Controller is not natively compatible with iOS devices.
specs.Compatible Windows Games: The HGWorld PS4 Wireless Controller supports Windows-based gaming for popular titles that allow controller input, ensuring smooth and precise gameplay.
specs.OS Supported: The HGWorld PS4 Wireless Controller is compatible with PlayStation 4, Windows PC, and Android devices. It does not support iOS or other platforms.
specs.Type: The HGWorld PS4 Wireless Controller connects wirelessly via Bluetooth, ensuring a lag-free and seamless gaming experience on PlayStation 4 consoles.
